29 Mar 2017 | News Release: https://www.adb.org/news/adb-help-improve-power-system-efficiency-coverage-bangladesh
Grant 9190: 100% of contracts awarded and 100% disbursed as of 29 Mar 2025
Loan 3522: 100% of contracts awarded and 100% disbursed as of 29 Mar 2025
Loan 3523: 100% of contracts awarded and 100% disbursed as of 29 Mar 2025

Progress Toward Outcome: All intended outputs has been completed under the project. The Aminbazar-Moawa-Mongla 400 kV Transmission line has been constructed, commissioned and is now fully operational. The line serves as a major transmission highway for Bangladesh and enables the power flow from the southern zone to Dhaka and nearby area. DESCO's SCADA system is fully activated. New connections were provided by BREB as planned which has enhanced the distribution network.
Some results are in the Audited Project Financial Statements | Feb 2025: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/49423/49423-005-apfs-en_19.pdf
Some results are in the Initial Environmental Examination | Sep 2016: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents//49423-005-iee-01.pdf
Some results are in the Social Monitoring Reports | Jul 2023: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/49423/49423-005-smr-en_14.pdf

Status of Implementation Progress: Output 1: PGCB. Output Achieved. A total of 179 km 400 kV transmission line has been constructed connecting Aminbazar with Mongla through Mawa. Four Contracts were awarded under PGCB for the construction of the 400 kV AMM transmission line and one substation. Details are:
i. Aminbazar 400 kV substation: Turnkey contract was signed on 30 September 2018. The substation was energized on 30 June 2021. All works completed and the substation is in operation since June 2021.
ii. The Padma River Crossing Component: The Aminbazar-Maowa-Mongla 400 kV Double Circuit Transmission Line has a 7.5 km river crossing section across the Padma River. PGCB awarded the contract to KEC International Ltd, India on 12 June 2018. The 7.5 km transmission line was energized on 15 Dec 2022.
iii. Aminbazar-Gopalgonj line: The turnkey contract was signed on 23 December 2018. All works for this has been completed for the 76 km 400 kV line in July 2022. The line is now fully energized.
iv. Gopalgonj-Maowa line: Turnkey contract was signed on Dec 2018. The 96 km 400 kV transmission line is fully energized.
Output 2. DESCO. Output fully achieved. All 68 substations are connected with SCADA system as planned. The system is fully operational since 2020.
Output 3. BREB. The output has been fully achieved. A total of 38,000 km 33 and 11 kV distribution lines and associated transmission facilities have been rehabilitated. A total of 12,000 km 33 and 11 kV distribution lines and associated facilities are constructed.
Output 4. Capacity Building. Achievement exceeded target. 351 BPL consumers including 35% women have been trained on selected businesses. 1,585 newly electrified consumers have been trained on safe, efficient & productive use of electricity. As envisaged, tariff petitions have been annually submitted by PGCB, DESCO and BREB to BERC.
A GIS based mapping system has been implemented for NESCO in Dec 2022. Training of women employee on GIS mapping completed for BREB under Grant 9190.
2 studies for l4 land based solar and wind project development have been completed. Women friendly measures and activities completed.
Tenders and Contracts Awarded: https://www.adb.org/projects/49423-005/main#project-tenders
